lead.tldr: Trump Media files SEC applications for Bitcoin, Ether, and Cronos ETFs with Crypto.com custody. • PGI CEO sentenced to 20 years for $200M crypto fraud targeting 90,000 investors. • Bitcoin rises 4% on soft CPI data but faces $70K resistance level. • Binance dismisses investigators uncovering $1B Tether flows to Iran wallets. • Grayscale seeks NYSE Arca listing for AAVE token trust conversion to ETF. • Secretary Bessent warns Congress must pass crypto reform by spring deadline.

top_signals.title: Trump Media Files Bitcoin, Ether and Cronos Crypto ETFs with SEC
top_signals.summary: Truth Social Funds, the cryptocurrency investment arm of Trump Media & Technology Group, filed registration statements with the SEC on February 13, 2026, for two digital asset exchange-traded funds: the Truth Social Cronos Yield Maximizer ETF and the Truth Social Bitcoin and Ether ETF. Crypto.com will serve as the digital asset custodian, liquidity provider, and staking services provider for both funds, while Yorkville America Equities will act as investment adviser with a 0.95% annual management fee. The Cronos fund will provide exposure to the Cronos token plus staking rewards, while the Bitcoin and Ether fund will offer combined exposure to both cryptocurrencies including Ether staking returns. The funds cannot commence operations or offer shares until the SEC declares the registration statement effective, marking Trump Media's expansion into cryptocurrency investment products.

top_signals.title: PGI CEO Gets 20 Years Over $200M Crypto Investment Scheme
top_signals.summary: PGI CEO Ramil Palafox was sentenced to 20 years in prison for a $200 million crypto investment scheme. Prosecutors stated that over 90,000 investors were misled by false Bitcoin trading claims.

top_signals.title: Anthropic's $380 billion valuation vaults it next to OpenAI, SpaceX among largest IPO candidates
top_signals.summary: Anthropic's valuation has increased significantly after raising $30 billion in its latest funding round, placing it among the largest potential IPO candidates alongside OpenAI and SpaceX. The company's valuation is now estimated at $380 billion.

top_signals.title: Wallet tied to $200M Mixin Network hack moves ETH after over two years of dormancy: onchain data
top_signals.summary: A wallet associated with the $200 million Mixin Network hack from over two years ago has moved ETH, depositing funds on Tornado Cash and selling ETH. This indicates the hacker is attempting to launder the stolen funds.

top_signals.title: Binance fires top investigators who claim to have uncovered evidence of Iranian sanctions violations
top_signals.summary: Binance reportedly fired investigators who uncovered evidence of Iranian sanctions violations. Internal findings suggest over $1 billion in Tether flowed through Binance to Iran-linked wallets.

top_signals.title: Grayscale files to convert AAVE token trust into ETF to list on NYSE Arca
top_signals.summary: Grayscale has filed to convert its AAVE trust into an exchange-traded fund (ETF). The ETF is planned to be listed on the NYSE Arca exchange.

top_signals.title: All about Aave Labs’ ‘token-centric’ plan to direct 100% revenue to DAO
top_signals.summary: Aave Labs is planning to direct 100% of its revenue to the DAO. The DAO criticized Aave Labs' $50 million request as 'extraction'.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin price surges on CPI relief – Yet BTC’s $70K barrier remains!
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin's price increased following positive CPI data, but the $70,000 resistance level remains a challenge. The article suggests a potential breakout or short-squeeze scenario for Bitcoin.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Gains 4% As Soft US CPI Boosts March Rate-Cut Odds
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin experienced a 4% price increase following the release of softer-than-expected US CPI data, which has increased the likelihood of a March rate cut. The market reacted positively to the inflation data.

top_signals.title: BlackRock Goldman and CitiGroup lead Wall Street’s crypto hiring spree
top_signals.summary: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and CitiGroup are leading a crypto hiring spree on Wall Street, indicating increased interest and investment in the crypto space by traditional finance institutions. Recruiters anticipate further recruitment in traditional finance for crypto-related roles.

top_signals.title: Microsoft AI chief gives it 18 months — for all white-collar work to be automated by AI
top_signals.summary: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman predicts that AI will automate all white-collar work within 18 months. He believes the current AI computational power will accelerate this disruption.

top_signals.title: Spring or Bust: Secretary Bessent Declares Deadline for Crypto CLARITY
top_signals.summary: Secretary Bessent states that Congress must pass crypto reform by spring or risk losing the opportunity. The article highlights the urgency for crypto regulation.
